scope: Windows low-power auxiliary condition; Node on the same Windows host requests the isolated KonomiTV backend directly. No Chrome, Akebi proxy, decoder, or player in the request path. Not a seek latency measurement.

conditions.runtimeReset: Fresh backend process for each mode

method.firstAndLast: Median of first 20 and last 20 samples in original request order
method.counter: Win32_Process logical read transfers for the backend process, not physical disk or network bytes

candidate.application: Only starlette/responses.py replaced in the isolated environment; same player, dependencies and request sequence. No bounded Range change.

exclusions.reason: Launcher exited during cleanup and identity validation failed. Not used; fresh rerun has successful cleanup.

limitations: One ordered baseline/candidate pair, not a randomized repeated comparison.
HTTP receive time and logical I/O only; Chrome playback, fatal stop incidence, autoFilm and A/V sync not measured here.
